name: FireStorm Air-to-Ground Missile Rack
description: The FireStorm Air-to-Ground Missile Rack was a model of starship-mounted missile launcher. The racks were retractable and held two-hundred and fifty missiles that could be fire singly or in one salvo. The HT-2200 medium freighter Reekeene's Retribution mounted two FireStorm launchers. The launchers could only be fired in atmosphere.
